purpose: 第一条完整旅程的类型、分支、客观事件和存档边界；不替代原剧本，不宣称经过运行验证。

scopeExclusions: 实际后续生态观测结果

presentedDialogueId.source: ID whose complete audio or readable caption was actually presented from an allowed cue/transcript; never inferred from a learner answer

dialogueDeliveryValidated.source: presentation adapter confirms the ID was available in the current node/global cue, its applicable guard held, and its complete audio OR readable transcript was provided

effects.assign: evaluate value against before-state; assign field
effects.appendOnce: append immutable record only when uniqueBy is absent

expressionContract.effectOrder: All operands read pre-event state; effects commit atomically. No condition contains free prose or executable source.
expressionContract.transitionSelection: Current-node and applicable global transitions match event ID. Exactly one must match its guard; zero rejects without mutation, multiple is a contract error.
expressionContract.dynamicTargets: Only currentNodeId self-target or resume.nodeId; resume.nodeId must be in declared active nodeId enum.
expressionContract.inputPolicy: Validate types/enums and context provenance. No English sentence pattern, word count or grammar keyword guard.
expressionContract.dialoguePolicy: performed cues use triggerOn and guards; self-transitions do not create node_enter. Cues and replay never write domain state. optional_learner_support remains visible as a selectable example and never impersonates the student.

presentationTriggers.node_enter: an actual graph-node change, not a self-transition
presentationTriggers.cast_arrived: the relevant actual character reaches its speaking position; re-evaluate pending cues only
presentationTriggers.scene_resumed: the saved scene is restored and cast/caption availability is known
presentationTriggers.domain_event: only the named accepted committed event, not audio completion or an English keyword

expressionContract.deliveryReceipts: A cue with deliveryField remains pending until DIALOGUE_CONTENT_PRESENTED commits that exact ID. Explicit replay is allowed but cannot create a second domain action. Readable transcripts can provide core interview content without replaying audio; receipt means provided, not understood.

outcomes.visual: 与左侧无覆盖基线一致；标记沿裸土—浅沟—汇流口路径移动。
盖片落在无关区域；预设源头与路径未改变。
本教学场景中，盖住指定裸土后从该源头进入浅沟的土壤示意减少；其他来源保持未解释。

qualitativeModel.worldWritePolicy: TRIAL_COMPLETED never writes world fields; installing a cover never changes waterAppearance.

geometryBinding.source_cover_zone: loc.bare_bed内经灰模冻结的裸土表面区域
geometryBinding.unrelated_zone: 同一模型边界内，不覆盖源土或截断真实通行/水路的教学对照区

ASK_WATER_COLOUR_QUESTION.learnerIntent: Ask whether appearance alone tells us what is in the water; oral wording is free and not inspected.

MODEL_REPOSITION_REQUESTED.learnerIntent: Choose to move the existing cover in the model; not a grammar result and not an instruction to install it in the valley.

nodes.ui: 明确标注独立回访课例；Noor受邀同行，玩家尚未观察/清理/试验；选择课堂模式。
三处证据可任意次序；同屏同伴共享标来源；英语表达不触发关键词判分。允许随时收束。

readableTranscript.policy: Every core line can be opened here on either branch, including 007 skipped before leaving the neutral node. Each presented line persists separately; no answer or recitation is required.

nodes.ui: 三槽画面可留白；选真实记录、比较画面或已完成操作。caption/audio自由；同伴核对主张，不做语法关键词门槛。

nodes.optionalCastPolicy: Player arrival opens the card immediately. Rowan/Mei lines may follow when that speaker arrives; saving or leaving does not wait for them. Undelivered cues remain eligible on the next return; receipts suppress unrequested repeats.

nodes.outcome: 保存本课已发生的事；不代表生态问题解决。
保存后暂停；恢复安全交互点，未完成试验不补成完成。
保存未解问题；允许少量证据、无试验或无实施。

storageContract.idempotence: Existing eventId with identical event name, input and schema hash returns the original committed result; differing content using the same ID is rejected. expectedRevision mismatch reloads latest state without automatic replay.
storageContract.animation: Manipulations are previews until commit. PLAY/REPLAY/SEEK/SKIP/AUDIO_END never dispatch domain completion by themselves.
storageContract.storageFailure: No transition/effect becomes committed. Keep the current scene with a visible retry/discard/export overlay. Retry reuses command ID. Do not say saved.
storageContract.refresh: Recover latest complete committed revision; ignore incomplete journal tail. If model.phase is running, commit INTERRUPTED_TRIAL_RECOVERED before enabling new actions; retain completed trials and do not invent a result.
storageContract.inFlightPause: PAUSE_SAVED cancels running model without appending result. Carry/draft placement fields are retained; restore validated transform against same layout version.
storageContract.versionMismatch: Block application of stale placement transforms; retain read-only records and propose explicit migration/copy, never silently move a permanent landmark.
storageContract.privacy: Local classroom records by default; no account, network room, automatic message or cloud upload.
storageContract.navigationResume: On reopening, start at the saved safe anchor navigation.currentLocation; if a destination remains, visibly offer continuing that walk. Do not alter permanent object transforms.
storageContract.draftResume: Restore carried/draft cover state only with the same frozen layout version; material still exists exactly once. If its transform fails validation, keep the save read-only and request an explicit recovery to the tools table.
storageContract.recoveryEventIdentity: Recovery command ID is stable for the loaded save ID and interrupted trial revision, so a retry cannot create repeated recovery events.
storageContract.blobFailure: If a referenced frame/audio blob is missing, keep that media slot pending and offer explicit replacement/removal; never silently publish a different image or claim the missing recording was saved.
storageContract.asyncCompletion: TRIAL_COMPLETED requires input.runId equal to the active run ID. Cancelling, pausing or recovering clears activeRunId, so a late animation callback cannot finish a newer run.
storageContract.dialogueResume: Persist delivery.T03S.* booleans with the same atomic revision. The follow-up interview always exposes 007/009/011 transcript, so skipping a previous cue or restoring midway cannot strand the scene. Optional return/cleanup cues wait for actual cast presence and never gate saving.

invariants: No event changes world.waterAppearance in this slice.
No event appends followup.observations; a saved return card is planned only.
A failed/cancelled trial does not append a trial record.
No student free-text content affects transition availability.
Terminal outcomes are saved activity states, never a claim of ecological restoration.
Only current public/committed evidence, actual trials and actual implementation are offered as explanation media.

publicEvidenceCatalog.datePolicy: Fictional story date labels are displayed on authored records; no real-world field measurement is claimed.

Exposed soil, shallow channel and visible route; possible source only

publicEvidenceCatalog.newCameraPolicy: cam.upper_observation.slice1 is an additional camera in the same v3 world, with transform frozen after blockout; it does not create another upstream location.
